notes: Catalysis paper (gas-phase hydrodechlorination of chlorobenzene over Pd and Ni, bulk and on AC, graphite, GNF, Al2O3, SiO2). Its only H2 uptake values are pulse H2 chemisorption volumes (cm3/g) in Table 1, measured in a CHEMBET 3000 flow unit with N2 carrier; I judged this a flow method, so I1 is met, and the Pd/AC, Ni/AC, Pd/GNF and similar catalysts are metal-decorated carbons (about 8 wt% metal), so I2 is met. Table 1 reports BET area (single-point method) for every sample, so I4 is met. I3 is the decisive and borderline call: the temperature of the chemisorption is given only as 'room temperature' / 'ambient conditions', which the registered schema treats as not stated (words are not a number and are not imputed), and the 0.004 atm figure is the maximum per-pulse partial pressure, not the pressure of the saturation uptake value. TPD (Fig. 5) is a desorption ramp and does not supply uptake conditions. If I1 were read as not met (chemisorption on metal sites in a catalyst study), the code would still be no_conditions_stated. Not a review, not retracted (is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the text), no statement that the uptake values were published before. No supplementary files in the input.
